observations: The API response includes the full Arabic wikitext at a fixed revision; the wikitext is preserved in candidate.json and in the archived search response.
The page labels the cake a traditional American recipe in its opening sentence. This is preserved as an unreviewed source observation; recipe.cuisine remains null.
The page contains eight ingredient lines and six numbered steps under the concise method. It also contains a separate detailed method in the preserved raw wikitext.
Eight explicit source quantity strings were transcribed to separate unreviewed candidates. Canonical amount/unit, ingredient identity, and food binding remain null.
No numerical preparation/cooking duration or servings count is stated. All step duration values and servings remain null.
The page includes file/image references. No media files were fetched or copied.
Siteinfo reports Arabic and CC BY-SA 4.0. This verifies the sitewide policy evidence only; page-level exceptions and third-party attributions remain unreviewed.
discoveryNotes: The allcategories query found the category label وصفات مختارة; its members query returned no pages.
The allcategories prefix طبخ query returned no categories.
A bounded namespace-0 search for وصفة returned the candidate page and four unrelated language-learning pages; only the recipe-shaped candidate was extracted.
limitations: 01-siteinfo.json retains the complete parsed response and its original response-body SHA256, but not the exact raw response-body bytes.
Arabic recipe parser coverage has not been generalized beyond this fixed archived revision.
No deduplication against English/French/Spanish recipe pools was performed; the title is not claimed to be a globally unique dish.
reviewStatus: research-only; no nutrition, food identity, quantity normalization, cuisine approval, or runtime import
